newsitem.title: USA: Integrated Medical shares up, Advanced Radio flat.
newsitem.headline: Integrated Medical shares up, Advanced Radio flat.

text.p: In their first day of trading Wednesday, shares of Integrated Medical Resources Inc rose 7/16 at 6-7/16 and shares of Advanced Radio Telecom Corp were unchanged at 15 by midafternoon.

Integrated Medical, a Kansas-based provider of disease management services for men suffering from impotence, made its Nasdaq market debut with 2.5 million shares priced at $6 each, lead underwriter Hambrecht & Quist Inc said Wednesday.

Advanced Radio, a Washington-based provider of wireless transmission of voice, data and video using point-to-point microwave signals, also made its market debut Wednesday with 2.25 million shares priced at $15 each.
Lead underwriter Merrill Lynch said the deal was priced at the lower end of a range of $15 to $18 a share and opened on the Nasdaq at 15-3/8.
